summary: Preserve every distinct exact RFI and Submittal reference when multiple workflow markers occur on one line.
decision_refs: The active goal requires better RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy and adaptability
FR-WORKFLOW-001 requires exact references to remain reviewable without guessed matches
Offline reproduction showed the first greedy marker suppressing later exact identifiers on the same line
approval_evidence: The persistent user goal explicitly requires continued accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: Reference extraction remains exact and deterministic; relationships and contractual effects are not inferred from conjunctions or prose.
Each marker retains the existing bounded same-line candidate and digit-bearing identifier rules.
Repeated canonical identifiers still collapse to one reference.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no customer email, mailbox or provider API is used.
